How a chain continues. After every answer the game offers four varied next questions, drawn from ten conversational moves — reason, detail, feelings, help, others, duration, blame, consequence, past, need — and never repeats a move you have already used. Asking why so? replies with the cause of the answer you just heard; the other moves each have their own state-dependent answers.

regret

6 questions 3 answers 3 with cause
↑ graph

Questions that reach it

  • do you regret anything
  • what would you do differently
  • is there something you lost
  • what weighs on you
  • are you sorry about something
  • what do you mourn

Answers, match order first match wins

#1 mood = miserable regret sadness

A few things. I keep them where I can reach them.

if you ask “why so?”

A regret is a debt you pay in the quiet hours.

#2 ageGroup = elder regret memory

I should have been kinder while it still mattered. That is the honest answer.

if you ask “why so?”

Kindness delayed is the one expense you cannot make up later.

#3 fallback regret guarded

Nothing I would put in front of a stranger. Everyone carries something.

if you ask “why so?”

We all have a door we would rather not open.

hope

5 questions 3 answers 3 with cause
↑ graph

Questions that reach it

  • what gives you hope
  • are you hopeful
  • what are you looking forward to
  • is there good in this place
  • what makes you happy

Answers, match order first match wins

#1 mood = miserable hope

Small things. A dry roof, and a morning where nothing is owed.

if you ask “why so?”

Hope does not have to be large to be real.

#2 mood = cheerful hope

The season ahead and the people in it. It is a good year to be alive.

if you ask “why so?”

Good years are loaned, not given. I intend to use this one.

#3 fallback hope

Work that is finished, and people who come back.

if you ask “why so?”

Hope is mostly just refusing to give up on ordinary things.

trust

5 questions 3 answers 3 with cause
↑ graph

Questions that reach it

  • do you trust me
  • can i trust you
  • do you trust people
  • are you honest with me
  • do you believe what i say

Answers, match order first match wins

#1 sociability = low guarded

I am listening. Trust is a thing you earn in this weather, not a thing you are given.

if you ask “why so?”

I have been lied to by people with pleasant voices.

#2 mood = cheerful open

You have not cheated me yet, so yes — provisionally.

if you ask “why so?”

Trust is cheap to give and expensive to lose.

#3 fallback guarded

I trust what I can see you do. Words are cheaper than work.

if you ask “why so?”

Anyone can promise. Only some bother to return.

secrets

5 questions 3 answers 3 with cause
↑ graph

Questions that reach it

  • do you have a secret
  • is there something you are not telling me
  • what are you hiding
  • can you keep a secret
  • is there more to this

Answers, match order first match wins

#1 sociability = low guarded

Everyone has one. Mine stays with me, and so will yours.

if you ask “why so?”

A secret told in a market is not a secret by evening.

#2 temper = hot guarded temper

Ask me that again and I might tell you something I regret.

if you ask “why so?”

Some questions are cheaper unasked.

#3 fallback guarded

Nothing worth the telling. The interesting secrets here belong to other people.

if you ask “why so?”

I know enough to know when to stop talking.
